lines.en: scene black
The year is 2020...and {i}Lessons in Love{/i} has come to an end...
lines.zh: 现在是 2020 年……而《Lessons in Love》已经走到了尽头……

lines.en: But after ten long years of sorrow, trauma, and enough cum to submerge a small country, it is finally time to turn the page on the world you’ve come to know and love.
lines.zh: 但在长达十年的悲伤、创伤，以及足以淹没一个小国的精液之后，终于到了为你所熟知并深爱的那个世界翻页的时候了。

lines.en: Was that world ever {i}real{/i} at all, though?...
lines.zh: 可是，那个世界真的{i}存在过{/i}吗？……

lines.en: Exactly {i}how{/i} much of what you saw was authentic?
lines.zh: 你所看到的，到底{i}有多少{/i}是真实的？

lines.en: How much was meticulously crafted to capture your attention?
lines.zh: 又有多少是精心设计、只为抓住你的注意力的？

lines.en: How much was a {i}facade?{/i}
lines.zh: 又有多少只是一层{i}伪装{/i}？

lines.en: Today, that is what we’ll find out together...
lines.zh: 今天，就让我们一起找出答案……

lines.en: scene summervacation1
My name is Fred, and I am the God of Behind the Scenes Content.
lines.zh: 我叫 Fred，是「幕后内容之神」。

lines.en: And I am here to tell you that this world still moves with or without you.
lines.zh: 我来这里是要告诉你：不管有没有你，这个世界都照常运转。

lines.en: It just moves in ways that wouldn’t make much sense to someone without a hat.
lines.zh: 只是它运转的方式，对一个没戴帽子的人来说不太好懂。

lines.en: Now, please painstakingly tear apart that last sentence bit by bit until you find the deeper meaning that definitely exists.
lines.zh: 现在，请务必把最后那句话一点一点地拆开，直到你找到那个确实存在的深层含义。

lines.en: In the meantime, I am going to take you somewhere. Far beyond the reach of your imagination.
lines.zh: 与此同时，我要带你去一个地方。一个远远超出你想象的地方。

lines.en: It is the beach.
lines.zh: 是海滩。

lines.en: You just have a very uninteresting imagination.
lines.zh: 只是你的想象力太无趣了而已。

lines.en: scene black
What you are about to see is the truth you’ve been searching for.
lines.zh: 你即将看到的，正是你一直在寻找的真相。

lines.en: The real answer to what’s been buried beneath your feet.
lines.zh: 那个一直被埋在你脚下的真正答案。

lines.en: So close the game now if you aren’t prepared for that.
lines.zh: 所以如果你还没准备好，现在就关掉游戏吧。

lines.en: But if you’re still here...know this.
lines.zh: 但如果你还在……那就记住这一点。

lines.en: In Blythe, California, wearing cowboy boots is illegal unless you own two cows.
lines.zh: 在加州的布莱斯，穿牛仔靴是违法的，除非你拥有两头牛。

lines.en: scene summervacation2 with flash
: And then we cut to a shot of a weird looking worm. What do you think?
lines.zh: : 然后我们切到一个长得很怪的蠕虫的镜头。你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : I don’t know...I just don’t get how incorporating the same sort of...avant-garde or...{i}abstract{/i} messaging our first title had is going to help us make money at all when Lessons in Love was a total flop.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……我只是不明白，我们第一部作品那套……先锋派还是……{i}抽象{/i}的表达，到底怎么能帮我们赚钱——《Lessons in Love》可是彻头彻尾的失败作。

lines.en: : We never should have killed off Maya. There really was no recovering from that.
lines.zh: : 我们当初真不该把 Maya 写死。那之后确实再也回天乏术了。

lines.en: : Which is why I think we should play it safe this time around and completely avoid all of that...{i}artistic{/i} stuff in favor of something more...generic. Easy to understand.
lines.zh: : 所以我觉得这次该稳妥行事，彻底避开那些……{i}艺术性{/i}的东西，改做更……通俗、易懂的内容。

lines.en: : Understood. I’ll try and have a first draft done by the end of the week.
lines.zh: : 明白了。我尽量在本周末之前完成初稿。

lines.en: : No more gods either. Understood? The Tsukioka Foundation goes under if this next project bombs. My family’s legacy is riding on this, Nagasawa.
lines.zh: : 也不许再有「神」了。明白吗？要是下一部作品扑街，Tsukioka 财团就要完蛋。我家族的传承全押在这上面了，Nagasawa。

lines.en: : Yes, Miss Tsukioka. I understand completely. I apologize for my inadequacies and I will do better.
lines.zh: : 是，Tsukioka 小姐。我完全明白。为我的无能向您道歉，我会做得更好。

lines.en: scene summervacation3
: Okay, okay! Sorry for the interruption, guys! I know we’re all trying to enjoy the wrap party after ten years of hard work, but you know how Hollywood is.
lines.zh: : 好好好！抱歉打断一下各位！我知道大家努力了十年，正想好好享受杀青宴，可好莱坞就是这么回事。

lines.en: : This train never sleeps, which means that the earlier we get to work on our next project, the better! So I’ve got a staff list right here that we’ll go over really quickly before you can all get back to enjoying yourselves.
lines.zh: : 这列火车从不睡觉，所以我们越早开工下一部作品越好！我这儿有一份工作人员名单，我们很快过一遍，然后你们就能继续玩了。

lines.en: scene summervacation4
: And remember, this is a {i}team{/i} effort. So if anyone ever feels uncomfortable at any point, please speak up! We can’t help you if we don’t know what’s wrong.
lines.zh: : 还有记住，这是{i}团队{/i}协作。所以任何人只要觉得不舒服，请务必说出来！我们不知道问题出在哪，就没法帮你。

lines.en: : Before Ayane reads off the staff list, though, there is {i}one{/i} thing we need to announce. And it’s that our next work will be leaning heavier into pornographic aspects. So anyone who has an issue with that-
lines.zh: : 不过在 Ayane 念名单之前，有{i}一{/i}件事要宣布。那就是我们的下一部作品会更偏向色情方面。所以对此有意见的人——

lines.en: scene summervacation5 with dissolve
: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈到底是什么东西？！

lines.en: : Oh god, here we go again.
lines.zh: : 哦天哪，又来了。

lines.en: scene summervacation6 with flash
: Is this {i}really{/i} how you’re going to treat the {i}STAR?!{/i} I asked for a double short, low-fat, no foam latte and this is CLEARLY a double short, {i}non-{/i}fat, {i}low{/i} foam latte!
lines.zh: : 你{i}真的{/i}要这么对待本{i}明星{/i}吗？！我要的是双倍浓缩、低脂、无奶泡的拿铁，而这杯明显是双倍浓缩、{i}脱{/i}脂、{i}少{/i}奶泡的拿铁！

lines.en: scene summervacation7
: HOW AM I SUPPOSED TO WORK LIKE THIS?! Do you have the faintest idea how ICKY foam makes my mouth feel?! DO YOU?!
lines.zh: : 你让我怎么工作？！你到底知不知道那恶心的奶泡在我嘴里是什么感觉？！你知道吗？！

lines.en: scene summervacation8 with flash
: Sorry, Dad! I’ll do better next time.
lines.zh: : 对不起，爸爸！我下次会做好的。

lines.en: : FIX IT NOW OR YOU’RE GROUNDED FOREVER!
lines.zh: : 现在就给我改，不然你永远别想出门！

lines.en: : I’ll get right on that once we finish distributing jobs. We’re still down a few staff members since most of the supporting actors from LiL didn’t renew their contracts.
lines.zh: : 等我们把工作分配完，我马上去办。我们人手还缺几个，因为 LiL 的大部分配角都没续约。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, it looks like we’re going to have Io as gaffer again with Uta as spark and Makoto as DP.
lines.zh: : 说起这个，看起来 Io 还是当灯光师，Uta 当灯光助理，Makoto 当摄影指导。

lines.en: scene summervacation9
: Heh. DP. Like double penetration.
lines.zh: : 呵。DP。跟双插一样。

lines.en: : That’s what it’s called when there are two cocks that-
lines.zh: : 就是有两根鸡巴同时——

lines.en: : Do you really need to be this vulgar all the time, Io? Like, it’s totally possible to hear something mildly sexual and just {i}not{/i} make a joke out of it, you know.
lines.zh: : 你真的有必要一直这么下流吗，Io？听到点带点色的东西，也完全可以{i}不{/i}拿来开玩笑啊，你知道吧。

lines.en: scene summervacation10
: My bad, my bad. I guess I just forgot how sensitive you are when it comes to all this stuff as the only main character who never got a sex scene.
lines.zh: : 我的错，我的错。我大概是忘了，作为唯一一个从没有过性爱戏的主角，你在这类事上有多敏感。

lines.en: : I could have if I {i}wanted{/i} one, but I’m asexual. You know — like that one character you played for ten fucking years?
lines.zh: : 我{i}想{/i}有的话本来也能有，可我是无性恋。你知道吗——就像你他妈演了十年的那个角色一样？

lines.en: : A job’s a job, Uta. If anything, I think that character just made my OnlyFans even more popular. People are fucking {i}sick{/i} and I love it.
lines.zh: : 工作就是工作，Uta。要说的话，我觉得那个角色反而让我的 OnlyFans 更火了。人们真是{i}变态{/i}得要死，而我爱死了。

lines.en: : You going to weigh in on this at all or just stand there, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你要不要也说两句，还是就那么站着，Makoto？

lines.en: : I just want to go to sleep...
lines.zh: : 我只想睡觉……

lines.en: scene summervacation11
$ renpy.pause(4, hard=True)
scene summervacation12 with flash
: Hey, do you guys have a minute? I know the script isn’t done yet, but I’ve been looking over my lines and I’m not really sure what my character’s motivations are.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你们有空吗？我知道剧本还没写完，不过我一直在看我的台词，不太确定我这个角色的动机是什么。

lines.en: scene summervacation13
: Like, is this another “voices from beyond” sort of thing where I’m compelled to act in certain ways based on a divine connection?
lines.zh: : 比如说，这又是一种「来自彼方的声音」之类的设定吗——我被某种神圣的联系驱使着做出特定的行为？

lines.en: : Because, I’m fine with that if it’s what you want. But I was actually thinking we could take my character in a sort of different direction this time since that would make things less predictable.
lines.zh: : 因为如果这是你们想要的，我没问题。不过我其实在想，这次能不能把我的角色往某个不同的方向上带，这样剧情会没那么容易被猜到。

lines.en: : Your role is larger, but the direction of the character needs to stay the same or we’ll compromise the integrity of-
lines.zh: : 你的戏份更多了，但角色方向必须保持一致，否则会损害作品的完整性——

lines.en: : Nagasawa, let her speak. Miss Yasui is the only member of the cast who won an Academy Award, so we should, at the very least, hear her out.
lines.zh: : Nagasawa，让她说完。Yasui 小姐是剧组里唯一拿过奥斯卡奖的人，所以至少我们该听她把话说完。

lines.en: scene summervacation14
: Thank you very much! I truly did love playing such an interesting version of myself and feel like I learned a lot about acting in the process! Which is why I-
lines.zh: : 非常感谢！我真的很喜欢演绎这样一个有趣的自己，也觉得在这个过程中学到了很多表演上的东西！所以我才——

lines.en: scene summervacation15
: Hey, I think we’re done here. He’s having trouble getting it up again.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我觉得这边可以了。他又硬不起来了。

lines.en: : The cat ears didn’t help?
lines.zh: : 猫耳也没用吗？

lines.en: : I think he’s bored of them. I’ll try something new next time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他是玩腻了。下次我换点新花样。

lines.en: : Oh well. Ayane can pay you on the way out, as per usual.
lines.zh: : 好吧。Ayane 会在你出去的时候付钱给你，跟往常一样。

lines.en: : Thanks. Also, do you think I could get tomorrow off? My daughter has a ballet thing that I need to be there for.
lines.zh: : 谢了。还有，我明天能请个假吗？我女儿有芭蕾演出，我得去。

lines.en: : What time? You know how he gets with-
lines.zh: : 几点？你知道他那个人一……

lines.en: scene summervacation16
: I still have Rika’s number if a second woman is required. She could use the work.
lines.zh: : 如果需要第二个女人，我还有 Rika 的电话。她需要这份工作。

lines.en: : I suppose that works then. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 那这样就行了吧。谢谢。

lines.en: : No, thank you! This job’s way easier than the last one. And the less time we have to spend with that guy, the better.
lines.zh: : 不，该说谢谢的是我！这活儿比上一份轻松多了。而且跟那个家伙待的时间越少越好。

lines.en: scene summervacation17
: Ayane! My favorite DA, where’s my-
lines.zh: : Ayane！我最喜欢的地区检察官，我的——

lines.en: : Right here, Imani. Good work today. Same amount as usual. It’s all there.
lines.zh: : 在这儿，Imani。今天干得不错。数目跟往常一样。都在这儿了。

lines.en: : We’re...We’re hiring {i}prostitutes{/i} now? Shouldn’t we be a bit more...I don’t know...{i}professional?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们现在……在雇{i}妓女{/i}了？我们就不能更……我不知道……{i}专业{/i}一点吗？

lines.en: : It’s mostly a precaution. Akira’s been growing increasingly agitated with the lack of sex following Lessons in Love that I feel like I {i}have{/i} to hire them or he’ll go insane and wind up hurting one of us again.
lines.zh: : 主要是预防措施。《Lessons in Love》之后没有性爱，Akira 越来越焦躁，我觉得我{i}必须{/i}雇她们，不然他会发疯，然后再伤到我们中的某个人。

lines.en: : We could always just...get another lead, couldn’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们明明可以……换个男主角，不是吗？

lines.en: : With that sort of libido? Doubtful. He’s a necessary evil for viewer retention. There’s just no way around it at the moment.
lines.zh: : 就他那性欲？不太可能。为了留住观众，他是必要之恶。眼下实在没有别的办法。

lines.en: : R...Right...
scene summervacation18 with flash
: Are you talking about me over there?! Because you KNOW how I feel about people talking about me! And it’s NOT GOOD! This is supposed to be a SAFE SPACE!
lines.zh: : 你们在那边是在说我吗？！因为你们{i}知道{/i}我有多讨厌别人在背后议论我！而且这感觉一点都不好！这里应该是安全空间才对！

lines.en: : No one’s talking about you, my love. They all think you’re doing a great job! Because you {i}are{/i} doing a great job! You’re the most handsome, talented, special boy I’ve ever met and I love you very much.
lines.zh: : 没人在说你，亲爱的。他们都觉得你干得很棒！因为你{i}确实{/i}干得很棒！你是我见过最帅、最有才华、最特别的男孩，我好爱你。

lines.en: scene summervacation19
: My beloved wife. You are the moon that guides this wolf back home.
lines.zh: : 我挚爱的妻子。你是引这头狼回家的月亮。

lines.en: : And you are the sun that brings light to the garden of my heart...
lines.zh: : 而你是照亮我心之花园的太阳……

lines.en: : And I am going to puke.
lines.zh: : 而我要吐了。

lines.en: scene summervacation20
: Moving right along! Since we’re going to be leaning harder into the pornographic direction this time around, we’re going to need a fluffer. And that fluffer will be...Chika Chosokabe!
lines.zh: : 继续！既然这次要更偏向色情方向，我们就需要一个「助勃师」。而这个助勃师就是……Chika Chosokabe！

lines.en: scene summervacation21
: Me?! What?! Why?! Can’t somebody else do it?!
lines.zh: : 我？！什么？！为什么？！不能让别人来做吗？！

lines.en: : {i}Chika...not so loud...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Chika……小声点……{/i}

lines.en: scene summervacation22
: WHY ARE YOU ALWAYS SO MEAN TO ME?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是对我这么凶？！？！？！

lines.en: : She didn’t mean it, baby! She’s {i}happy{/i} to be the fluffer! She’s just worried her heart might explode from all of the feelings she-
lines.zh: : 她不是那个意思，宝贝！她{i}很高兴{/i}能当这个助勃师！她只是担心自己的心会因为满溢的感情而炸开——

lines.en: scene summervacation23 with flash
: I’LL BE IN MY TRAILER! CRYING! BECAUSE I’M SAD!
lines.zh: : 我要回我的拖车里！哭！因为我好难过！

lines.en: : Snookums! No! Come back, my wolf! Howl at your moon once more!
lines.zh: : 小亲亲！不要！回来吧，我的狼！再对你的月亮嚎叫一次！

lines.en: : Yumi, seriously...what do you even see in that abusive diva? How could you {i}marry{/i} him?
lines.zh: : Yumi，说真的……你到底看上那个会家暴的大牌明星哪一点？你怎么能{i}嫁给{/i}他？

lines.en: scene summervacation24
: How could you be so mean?! You know how sensitive he is! Just take one for the team and do this “fluffing” thing! How hard can that be?!
lines.zh: : 你怎么能这么刻薄？！你知道他有多敏感！就为团队牺牲一下，做这个「助勃」的活儿吧！能有多难？！

lines.en: : That means I’m responsible for keeping him hard on set! Why {i}me{/i} when {i}you’re{/i} here?! I don’t even like the guy and {i}you’re{/i} married to him!
lines.zh: : 那意思是我得负责在片场让他一直硬着！{i}你{/i}都在这儿了，为什么还要{i}我{/i}？！我根本就不喜欢那家伙，而{i}你{/i}才是嫁给他的那个！

lines.en: scene summervacation25
: I am here for {i}moral{/i} support. I don’t {i}like{/i} having intercourse in front of other people because I am self-conscious about the noises I make.
lines.zh: : 我是来提供{i}精神{/i}支持的。我不{i}喜欢{/i}在别人面前性交，因为我对自己发出的声音很在意。

lines.en: : But even so, if my hubby asked me to, I would. Which is also what you should do as my maid of honor.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此，如果我老公要我做，我也会做。这也是你作为我的伴娘该做的。

lines.en: : That was like eight years ago. And I wouldn’t have agreed to it at all if I knew it meant an apparent lifetime of having sex with your husband.
lines.zh: : 那都八年前的事了。而且我要是早知道这意味着要和你老公做一辈子爱，我根本就不会答应。

lines.en: scene summervacation26
: WHY ARE YOU ALWAYS SO MEAN TO ME?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是对我这么凶？！？！？！

lines.en: : Ugh...I wonder if it’s too late to back out of my contract.
lines.zh: : 呃……我在想现在解约还来不来得及。

lines.en: scene summervacation27 with flash
: On set decoration we’ll have...Otoha and Miku. Which should give them all the time in the world they need to...keep doing {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 布景方面我们有……Otoha 和 Miku。这应该能给她们足够多的时间，让她们继续做{i}那件事{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you know what I have in store for you tonight, my precious little kitten?
lines.zh: : 你知道我今晚为你准备了什么吗，我珍贵的小猫咪？

lines.en: : Surprise me...Anything is fine as long as it’s you, my prince...
lines.zh: : 给我个惊喜吧……只要是你，什么都可以，我的王子……

lines.en: : Even...{i}that?{/i}
: Y...You don’t mean...
lines.zh: : 你……你不是指……

lines.en: : Oh, I certainly do...
lines.zh: : 哦，我当然是……

lines.en: : You ever just...stop what you’re doing for a second and think about how crazy it is that all of us are so different from our characters in Lessons in Love?
lines.zh: : 你有没有过……停下手上的事，想想这有多疯狂——我们在《Lessons in Love》里的角色和真实的我们差别这么大？

lines.en: : I mean, you and me are more or less the same, aren’t we?
lines.zh: : 我是说，你和我基本上是一样的，对吧？

lines.en: : I guess. I never really jived with that whole “sex-pest” thing I was in the beginning of the game, though. I think it would have been nice to play a character more like you.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过我一直不太能接受游戏初期我那套「性骚扰狂」的设定。我觉得要是能演一个更像你的角色就好了。

lines.en: scene summervacation28 with flash
: How’s Karin, by the way? I heard she didn’t renew her contract. You guys still keep in touch?
lines.zh: : 对了，Karin 怎么样？我听说她没续约。你们还有联系吗？

lines.en: : Occasionally. She did wind up feeling like an actual sister to me by the end of the story.
lines.zh: : 偶尔。故事结束时，她对我来说确实像个真正的姐姐。

lines.en: : It’s still so crazy to me that you guys looked so much alike despite not actually being related. Great job to the casting department, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得很不可思议——你们明明没有血缘关系，却长得那么像。看来选角部门干得不错。

lines.en: : What’s crazier to me is that you and Akira actually {i}are{/i} related despite not looking that way at all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得更不可思议的是，你和 Akira 其实{i}真的{/i}有血缘关系，却一点都不像。

lines.en: scene summervacation29
: Kirin, shush. I told you that in secret, remember?
